title: pAIchart device-service descriptor
description: A descriptor hands a pAIchart pipeline a read-only MCP service to self-provision for one run (register -> read-only calls -> teardown). Contract: SPEC.md in this directory. Constraints mirror the platform's registry(action:'register') validation.

_comment.description: Free-prose provenance, caveats, rig notes. Encouraged.

name.description: Registry service name: lowercase kebab-case, unique at run time, reserved first-party names rejected.

description.description: What the service exposes and what it deliberately does not. Surfaced verbatim to discovering agents.

endpoint.description: The MCP endpoint URL. Use https:// - the platform reaches it from the internet; SSRF policy blocks private/metadata addresses.

category.description: Registry category. Drives the approval path: an auto-approving category lands ACTIVE immediately; a manually-approved one blocks an unattended run.

authType.description: How callers authenticate to your service.

transport.description: Informative (e.g. streamable-http); the platform derives transport from the endpoint scheme.

tools.description: Declare ONLY the read-only subset. Undeclared tools are never seen or offered by the pipeline - an offer-surface restriction; read-only-by-construction on the service side is the actual enforcement (SPEC.md, 'The read-only contract').

name.description: MCP tool name as your server exposes it.

description.description: What the tool does, stated read-only where applicable. Agents choose tools by this text.

inputSchema.description: The tool's JSON Schema. Prefer tight schemas - enums and additionalProperties:false are themselves guards.
